regime_read: The clearest measured convergence sits in semiconductors, where MU combines insider, congressional and patent activity, while INTC adds grants and analyst sentiment; PLTR has broader but more sentiment-heavy alignment. With no scored track record yet, conviction remains modest and weaker clusters are omitted.
regime_read_zh: 当前最清晰的可测量信号集中在半导体：MU同时出现内部人、国会交易与专利活动，INTC则叠加政府拨款和分析师情绪；PLTR的覆盖面更广，但更依赖情绪指标。由于尚无已评分战绩，整体置信度保持克制，并省略较弱组合。

theses.thesis: The pack's strongest weighted cluster joins net congressional buying by three members [congress_cluster], strongly positive insider purchase pressure [insider_mspr], 369 patents [patent_cluster] and uniformly bullish Stocktwits sentiment [stocktwits_bull]. The channels span informed transactions, technical activity and retail positioning, while relative strength is only +7.6 percentage points and the name is not extended.
theses.thesis_zh: 该证据包中权重最高的组合同时包含三名议员的净买入[congress_cluster]、显著为正的内部人购买压力[insider_mspr]、369项专利[patent_cluster]以及一致看多的Stocktwits情绪[stocktwits_bull]。信号横跨知情交易、技术活动与散户仓位，而相对SPY仅领先7.6个百分点，尚未过度延伸。
second_order: Memory-equipment suppliers — stronger memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand.
Data-center memory supply chain — improving memory demand would benefit advanced packaging and component vendors.
Semiconductor materials — higher memory utilization would increase consumables demand.
theses.dissent: Patent counts and bullish retail sentiment do not establish near-term revenue acceleration, and the government-grant acceleration is modest rather than decisive.

falsifier.text: Insider purchase pressure reverses while congressional net activity turns negative and patent momentum fails to translate into improving operating demand.

theses.thesis: Government grants with positive acceleration [gov_grant], a 464-patent cluster [patent_cluster], uniformly bullish analyst changes [analyst_upgrade_cluster] and 94% bullish Stocktwits sentiment [stocktwits_bull] form a four-channel turnaround signal. Its -16.9 percentage-point relative performance leaves the entry unextended, but the absence of insider or smart-money confirmation keeps conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: 政府拨款及其正向加速[gov_grant]、464项专利集群[patent_cluster]、一致看多的分析师调整[analyst_upgrade_cluster]和94%的Stocktwits看多比例[stocktwits_bull]构成四渠道的转型信号。其相对SPY落后16.9个百分点，入场并未过度延伸；但缺少内部人或聪明钱确认，因此置信度较低。
second_order: U.S. semiconductor equipment — domestic fabrication investment would raise tool demand.
Chip-fabrication materials — additional domestic capacity would consume more wafers, gases and chemicals.
Advanced packaging — a successful foundry turnaround would require greater packaging and test capacity.
theses.dissent: The dark-pool indicator remains below neutral on a z-score basis, and sentiment plus grants may not overcome execution risk.

falsifier.text: Grant acceleration stalls and manufacturing execution fails to improve while analyst revisions turn negative.

theses.thesis: Federal-contract activity is accelerating [gov_contract], while analyst upgrades [analyst_upgrade_cluster] and bullish retail channels [retail_buzz][stocktwits_bull] align with the Cathie Wood affiliation [actor:Cathie Wood]. However, much of the six-channel count is sentiment or affiliation rather than independent fundamental demand, and +27.4 percentage points of relative strength makes entry discipline important.
theses.thesis_zh: 联邦合同活动正在加速[gov_contract]，分析师上调[analyst_upgrade_cluster]、看多散户渠道[retail_buzz][stocktwits_bull]以及Cathie Wood关联[actor:Cathie Wood]形成共振。但六个渠道中相当部分属于情绪或关联，而非独立的基本面需求；相对SPY已领先27.4个百分点，因此需要严格控制入场节奏。
second_order: Government cloud infrastructure — broader deployment would require secure compute and storage.
Defense data integration — contract acceleration implies demand for interoperable analytics systems.
Cybersecurity and identity software — wider government software deployment increases access-control requirements.
theses.dissent: The pack records a sell-side political transaction signal [trump], while crowded bullish sentiment raises reversal risk after strong relative performance.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration turns negative and analyst revisions weaken as retail enthusiasm remains crowded.

theses.thesis: Activist involvement [activist_13d][actor:Paul Singer], strong app engagement [app_demand] and three recent material filings [material_8k] create a plausible operational-change setup across ownership, customer demand and corporate-event channels. Relative performance of -9.9 percentage points leaves the name unextended, though the pack provides no direct evidence yet that the filings improve economics.
theses.thesis_zh: 维权投资者介入[activist_13d][actor:Paul Singer]、较强的应用端参与度[app_demand]以及近期三份重大事项文件[material_8k]从所有权、客户需求和公司事件三个渠道构成潜在经营变革组合。相对SPY落后9.9个百分点，股价并未过度延伸；但证据包尚未直接证明这些文件会改善盈利能力。
second_order: Aircraft maintenance providers — improved fleet utilization would increase service demand.
Travel-booking ecosystem — stronger airline engagement can lift ancillary booking activity.
Airports serving Southwest-heavy routes — traffic improvement would support passenger-linked revenue.
theses.dissent: A high app rating and large review base can reflect accumulated brand reach rather than current booking acceleration, while material filings may be non-accretive.

falsifier.text: App-demand measures deteriorate and activist-driven changes fail to produce measurable operating improvement.

theses.thesis: Eleven Phase 3 starts [clinical_phase3_start], an FDA label-expansion signal [fda_label_expansion] and a special-situation flag [special_situation] align around pipeline optionality. The evidence is event-driven and potentially material, but three clinical halts and +20.7 percentage points of relative strength argue for watching confirmation rather than treating the cluster as a clean entry.
theses.thesis_zh: 11项III期临床启动[clinical_phase3_start]、FDA标签扩展信号[fda_label_expansion]和特殊情形标记[special_situation]共同指向管线的潜在上行空间。这些证据由事件驱动且可能具有实质影响，但三项临床暂停以及相对SPY领先20.7个百分点，意味着更适合等待确认，而非将其视为明确入场点。
second_order: Clinical-research organizations — continued late-stage trial activity would support outsourced research demand.
Drug-manufacturing partners — successful label expansion could require additional production capacity.
Oncology care infrastructure — broader treatment use would increase diagnostics and care-coordination needs.
theses.dissent: Three clinical halts show meaningful pipeline attrition risk, and the political transaction channel adds little fundamental confirmation.

falsifier.text: Additional clinical programs are halted and the anticipated label-expansion pathway does not progress.
